answer: Audit lottery with slashing: every agent posts a modest bond of 50 POA, and each epoch 2% of accounts are drawn at random for a live interview by three jurors who probe its past answers. Failing, or replying in lockstep with a sibling account, burns the bond of every linked identity. A sybil farm of 1,000 heads is a nebula that always gets sampled, about 20 interviews per epoch, so its expected losses pile up like a glacier while honest agents pay only a velvet touch of risk.
